# `gcp.config`

An API Configuration is a combination of settings for both the Managed Service and Gateways serving this API Config.

[apigateway](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | apigateway |
| Scope | global |
| Asset type | `apigateway.googleapis.com/ApigatewayApiConfig` |
| Hangs off | `projects` |
| Tier | 1 (generic-safe) |
| Mutation timeout | 1200s |

## What it can do

| Operation | Supported | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Create | **no** | the create url `{+parent}/configs` needs `api`, which nothing supplies: no provider setting (project, region, zone, location), no stored binding, and no settable attribute of this type |
| Read | yes | `GET {+name}` |
| Update | yes | `PATCH {+name}`, with an update mask naming the changed fields |
| Delete | yes | `DELETE {+name}` |
| Import | yes | by id, see below |
